title: Floral Print Midi Dress
description: A flowing midi dress in a bold floral print on a deep navy ground. Features a V-neckline, button-front bodice, short sleeves, and a tiered hem on breathable fabric.

title: Classic Black Leather Handbag
description: A timeless structured handbag in smooth black leather. Twin top handles, a front flap pocket, and silver-tone hardware — effortlessly elegant for everyday wear.

title: Olive Wide-Leg Trousers
description: Relaxed wide-leg trousers in a soft olive green. High-waisted with a fluid, floor-grazing leg — tailored to move with you in the Egyptian heat.

title: Red Embroidered Occasion Dress
description: A statement occasion dress in vivid red with delicate floral embroidery throughout. Wrap-style bodice, woven belt, and a full flared skirt — made for weddings, engagements, and celebrations.

title: Ribbed Knit Crop Top
description: A soft ribbed knit crop top in powder blue with a straight neckline and thin straps. Versatile enough to pair with high-waisted trousers or layer under a blazer.

title: Pleated Chiffon Midi Skirt
description: A fluid ivory midi skirt in finely pleated chiffon. Elegant drape with a comfortable elastic waistband — easy to dress up or down.

title: Grey Check Double-Breasted Blazer
description: A sharp double-breasted blazer in a classic grey check. Sharp lapels, flap pockets, and a relaxed longline cut — the kind of piece that elevates everything underneath.

title: Pearl Drop Earrings
description: Delicate faux pearl drop earrings suspended from polished gold-tone studs. Lightweight and elegant — the finishing touch for any outfit.

title: Red Satin Evening Gown
description: A sweeping red satin gown with a plunging V-neckline and a dramatic thigh-high slit. Floor-length and fluid — for evenings that deserve something extraordinary.

title: Printed Silk Scarf
description: A luxurious silk scarf in a rich floral print with a deep red border. Wear as a headscarf, tie around the neck, or knot through a bag handle.

title: Embroidered Open Abaya
description: A black open-front abaya with contrast white embroidery along the lapel and front panels. Fluid, floor-length, and worn over a crisp white inner layer.

title: Tan Leather Tote
description: A tote in rich tan leather that develops character with every wear. Clean rectangular silhouette, spacious main compartment, and sturdy shoulder handles — built for daily elegance.

title: Printed Maxi Kaftan Dress
description: A relaxed maxi kaftan in a blue and white block print. Wide sleeves, a V-neckline, side slits, and a drawstring waist — effortlessly cool for warm Egyptian evenings.

title: Belted Crepe Abaya
description: A taupe crepe abaya with a slim self-tie belt at the waist and softly flared cuffs. Clean lines and a fluid drape — made for special occasions.

title: Oversized Beige Blazer
description: An oversized blazer in soft beige with dropped shoulders and a relaxed fit. Wear open over a slip top or buttoned as a standalone piece.

title: Pinstripe Palazzo Trousers
description: Sweeping high-waisted palazzo trousers in black with a bold white pinstripe. Full-length wide legs — elegant movement with every step.

title: Striped Off-Shoulder Ruffle Top
description: A breezy off-shoulder top in navy and white Breton stripes. Elasticated neckline with a layered ruffle overlay — pairs perfectly with tailored trousers.

title: Wide Gold Cuff Bracelet
description: A bold wide cuff bracelet in high-polish gold-tone metal. Slightly adjustable opening, smooth domed profile — a statement piece worn alone or stacked.

title: Floral Maxi Wrap Dress
description: A floor-length wrap dress in ivory with a scattered rose print. Tie waist, V-neckline, and a flowing slit skirt that flatters every figure.

title: Black Satin Lace-Trim Cami
description: A minimalist black satin cami with a delicate lace-trimmed neckline and thin adjustable straps. Layer under a blazer or wear alone for understated elegance.
